49007.description:
A 4-panel manga.

Yamada has a goal when she enters High School. She wants to make 100 sex friends, but she's got one small problem: she's a virgin! Afraid of being rejected or ridiculed by hot guys, she decides that in order for her to reach her goal she first has to lose her virginity. While in a bookstore looking for a new dictionary she bumps into Kosuda, a very average boy, and decides he's the perfect candidate to get the job done.

Will Yamada succeed in getting Kosuda to bed, or will something more bloom from the not so innocent start to their relationship?

Note: This entry contains 15 extra chapters.

49008.description: Shogo Ban is now a chef at Ristorante Legare. As the Yokohama branch of the Trattoria Baccanale he used to work at, he has been entrusted with the responsibility of head of the pasta section. Rejoin Ban as he struggles to meet the expectations of work and develop his personal relationships.

49009.description: Hayasaka is a mangaka who just turned in his last manuscript to his editor, Sakurai. Somehow, she loses it before submitting it.

49010.description: Cecile wakes up one morning with a boy from her university beside her. Exactly how much did they drink last night? And now what are they going to do?

49011.description:
The king of hearts is the king that captures all girls' hearts.
Yui, a teacher at a cram school, is a girl who always helps anyone in trouble. After seeing her neighbor, Sakimoto, collapse on the street, it was only natural for her to nurse him back to health. But when she did, she started to be interested in this somewhat mean guy...?!

49017.description: Konata and her friends continue on with their school life adventures in this anthology comic series.

title.native: らき　☆　すたコミックアラカルト　～はっぴーストライク！～
title.romaji: Lucky☆Star: Comic a la Carte - Happy Strike!

49018.description: Pilot chapter for what eventually evolved into To-Love-Ru.

49027.description: Tohru is a policeman who works at a police box when he confronts a teenager for shoplifting who turns out to be his one and only younger cousin, Takafumi! As children, Takafumi was constantly mean to Tohru, but now...

title.english: The Boundary Line between; Love and Hate; The Boundary Line of the; Hated and the Likes

49028.description: The adventures of Popuri in Nikoniko Ginza as she learns magic from Fukiko-san in her magical pharmacy, Fun Fun Pharmacy.

title.native: ファンファン・ファーマシィー

49029.description:
Hatsune grew up with the gentle Ken'ichi-niichan and the mean Kenji. Hatsune wants to become Ken'ichi-niichan's bride when she grows up, but he already has a girlfriend. Though, one day, she hears from Kenji that they've broken up. Time for her to launch attacks on Ke'ichi-niichan!

(Sorce: MangaUpdates)

title.native: ファースト・ロマンス

49031.description: Ayaka tries top be normal, but she’s got a secret – that she’s descended from a legendary line of fighters. Everyone knows she’s strong at martial arts, but she’s much stronger than she lets one. And then one day she’s attacked by someone with nearly her speed, only to be rescued by a strange boy who is stronger still. And so a battle for control over the spirits that give Ayaka her fighting skill begins…

49033.description:
Four years have passed since the final battle between Celestial Being and the UN Forces, but Setsuna and the Meisters face a new adversary - the A-Laws! The battle to unite humanity continues!

(Source: Amazon)

This manga based on the second season is illustrated by Kouzou Oomori and follows on from her manga based on the first series.
Bandai Entertainment holds the English license.

49035.description:
The Secret Behind the Masked Wrestling Hero!?

He’s 168 cm tall and takes down giant wrestlers like they’re nothing. A mysterious masked wrestler known as “Aon” has become a hero to children everywhere. But one day—the person inside the mask changes!? And the new Aon wastes no time making a jaw-dropping announcement: he’ll take on 336 wrestlers from 40 different organizations in a no-fake, no-scripted, real-deal shoot match!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated) Note: Includes the following one-shots
Volume 1: Bonnou Soukou Zenkaizer (煩悩装甲ゼンカイザー)
Volume 2: Gorgeous Family (ゴージャスファミリー), and Senorita Shounen (ゼンリョク少年)
synonyms: 煩悩装甲ゼンカイザー
ゴージャスファミリー

49037.description:
1-4. Kono Negai ga Kanau nara (この願いが叶うなら)
About a trio of friends that become involved in a complicated love triangle.

5. Utsukushii Mono (うつくしいもの)
The protagonist likes to watch another girl because she's beautiful.

6. Love Letter (ラブレター)
The protagonist is in love with a girl, but the girl has a crush on one of the protagonist's male friends. She asks the protagonist to give the love letter to her friend.

7. Kurozukume no Onnanoko (黒づくめの女の子)
A girl protects the woman she loves.

8. Ame to Hatsukoi (雨と初恋)
About a worrywart and the girl who always assuages her worries.

9. Mahou no Jumon (魔法の呪文)

49040.description: The valkyries, including the daughter of Odin, are captured by Duke and become dark-valkyries . They kill Odin and so begins the rule of the dark kingdom.

title.native: 戦乙女ヴァルキリー２　主よ、淫らな私をお許しください…
title.romaji: Ikusa Otome Valkyrie 2  Shuyo, Midara na Watashi wo Oyurushi Kudasai...

49048.description:
Debochi Amon (14) was always a passionate boy and had a tendency to literally steam up. Amon was living a normal life; going to school, hanging with friends and thinking about his crush on his classmate, Shinomoto Sako. One day, a third eye opens on his forehead after one of his usual "steaming" incidents and a talking owl creature who calls himself Goomin appears. Both characters are confused at the situation at hand and Goomin finally is able to explain the situation to Amon.

Amon now possesses Pyrokinesis and his power of his fire increases when his passion grows. His emotion of wanting to protect something, like his crush Shinomoto, triggers the transformation into a demonic figure and his flame is powered through greed. Now, Amon must learn to control and use his powers to protect the human world from Angels!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

49049.description: A cyberpunk-ish spin on the legendary hero, Momotarou.

title.native: 魔幻戦記 サイバー桃太郎

49051.description: Volume 3 - This is a story about a cat who lives with her wonderful owner, his not so loved boyfriend, a savage bird, and now a Corgi puppy. Can life be any more annoying?

49056.description: An alternate version of the original Mai-HiME manga.

49058.description:
1. World Apartment Horror (ワールド アパートメント ホラー)
Manga adaptation of Otomo's self-directed live-action film of the same name.
A bumbling Yakuza member is sent to rid an old and rotten apartment block of its foreign occupants, but finds it a lot harder than expected when he discovers an evil spirit still resides there.

2. Okyakusama (お客様, Visitors)
3. Waira (わいら)
4. Joyful Bell

title.native: ワールドアパートメントホラー

49059.description: Tamiko lives with her two brothers, her mom, and her grandmom. It's your typical family, or so she thought. But one day, she finds out Akira, her older brother, is not her brother at all, but the illegitimate child of famous actress Hanyuu Kaori. To make things even more confusing, Akira's feelings towards her isn't the kind towards a sibling, and with his persistence, she finds herself falling in love with him as well. The plot becomes even more complicated when Yukari, Tamiko's friend from school falls for Akira. Yukari though, has a connection with Akira that shocks everyone, including herself...

49061.description:
A collection of eleven short stories with a wide variety of subjects.

1. Kanojo no Kokuhaku
2. Kamen de Odorou
3. Jibun de Shinjita Otoko 2
4. Tada Soredake de
5. Shumi no Jikan
6. Wild Boys Blues
7. Television
8. Isoge Hayabusamaru
9. France no Kokuchou
10. Yokatta ne
11. Bus-tei

49065.description:
Private Ronald endures rigorous training day in and day out under the command of the base's most handsome but also toughest instructor, Captain Ashford. One day, when Ronald goes to deliver a package to the captain's office, he's struck by the image of his superior smiling in a photograph, and uses the opportunity to pleasure himself in the captain's absence. But what happens when the captain catches him in the act and insists that he's in need of some "punishment"...?
(Source: Nakama)

49067.description:
Zan Ruu lived a carefree lifestyle with his military father and brother. However, one day a mysterious airship attacked the capital, and danger approached Princess Emma. Zan hurried to rescue Princess Emma and the thing that appeared before him is......!?

To rescue Princess Emma, to seek the truth, the young man started his journey. A fantasy story revealed!!!
synonyms: Break Hands ~ Seiseki wo Tsugu Mono

title.native: ブレイクハンズ～星石を継ぐ者～
title.romaji: BREAK-HANDS: Inheritor of the Star Stone

49072.description:
Those who arrive at that shop carry desperate wishes within them — The enchanting and beautiful owner, the Owl, receives visitors like a ‘Man seeking the little finger of a promise', or a ‘Man carrying the child his brother gave birth to’ and even a ‘Young Fox holding its master’s bones in its mouth.’ They weave tales of forbidden love.

Chizoku, who is supposed to be the owl's lover, always feels down because he has no memory of their intimate moments... but that's because of Chizoku's hidden true identity...!? Also includes the wildly popular chibi character version. An "Ajian-style", bewitching romance tale.

(source: Libre, translated)

Notes:
- Volume 1 includes the extra "Chaa no Booken, Ohiru-hen (ちゃあのぼーけん、お昼編っ)"
- Volume 2 includes the extra "Chaa Shaa Nyaa (ちゃあしゃあにゃあ)", published in Libre Premium 2012: Pearl Platinum
- Includes the volume-exclusive extra "Chaa no Junan (ちゃあの受難)"
- Includes the one-shot "Amai, Amai. (あまい、あまい。)"
synonyms: ちゃあのぼーけん、お昼編っ

49073.description: It's about a robot named Robo, and a rabbit named Usakichi. As the title suggests, they travel space. Robo is living by himself on a tiny planet when one day Usakichi lands nearby after escaping from jail.

49074.description:
Stardust Memories is a short story compilation of human beings in the distant future where we have traveled deep into space. Each story describes a moral dilemma that people traveling in space may experience which is something that we have yet to determine in the current world.

Stardust Memories talk about such problems as the implications of having people travel for years, even decades, in the cold, quiet and endless universe. A different story tells on how human presence in a foreign galaxy will affect the environment. The topics the author decides to write about are interesting and makes you wonder about the future.

title.native: スターダストメモリーズ

49077.description:
1. Tsuki no Sabaku
Armageddon. The powerful weapon "Messiah" has ended the long war, leaving behind a barren wasteland. A boy wanders west, seeking the paradise that lies at the edge of the world. The man who created the weapon runs from those who would use him. Scattered by the winds of destruction, they meet, part ways, and then meet once again.

2. I'm Not Fit to be a Detective
An incompetent detective, born loser, and die-hard pacifist...so why on earth is Yagi suddenly commissioned with the task of driving a stubborn young woman out of the home that she claims her recently deceased grandfather left for her in his soon-to-be-revealed last will?

3. Dream Dweller
A little boy who 'hates' his strict grandfather makes a new friend...

4. Snowflakes
The love between a boy and his half-sister, set against the backdrop of a Japan soon to be torn apart by WW II.
synonyms: I'm Not Fit to be a Detective

49079.description:
¿What would you do if your school was enchanted by a ghost?
Undoubtedly, to call Ranto, the fortune-teller detective. But, what if he appears wearing a talking t-shirt, a fussy girlfriend, hairdresser that falls in love easily, and a Sushi's King candidate?
The resulting situation just can be this funny comedy by Satoru Akahori and Hitoshi Okuda.

title.native: 陰陽探偵少女遊RANTO☆魔承録

49081.description: Having to move schools from the Countryside to Tokyo, Chinami realizes that 'being like a girl' is quite vastly different!?

49082.description: A detailed look into the world of Appleseed including descriptions of people, places, history, and technology. Also includes, "Chapter 26. Called Game".

title.native: アップルシードデータブック

49087.description:
Recent high school transfer student Hasegawa Kodaka is pathetically inept at making friends. Kodaka is an outcast, with his natural blonde hair which he inherited from his deceased English mother, and his unpleasant, fierce gaze. When he comes across the brash loner Mikazuki Yozora, who typically chats with her imaginary friend, the two outsiders become the unlikeliest of allies.

Realizing that they have no hope of a normal social life, the two rejects decide to form a group called “The Neighbors Club” in order to make friends and maybe even learn a thing or two about social skills. As luck would have it, five new members join the club who are more socially awkward than they are. Will these quirky misfits ever make normal friends, or are they all doomed to social failure?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 11 extras.

title.english: Haganai: I Don't Have Many Friends

49089.description: One girl. A very poor high schooler. One that just happens to see a very rare brand of dog, who lost its way home. One that found the dog its owner. One that was granted an award - a gigantic house willed to her?! She can have the house, on one condition - she must watch over Gold, the dog, with love and care. And she will be graded by the original heir to the house... Oh my God, someone save her!

49091.description:
The manga volume consists of five shorter stories:

1. Sunroom Nite (サンルームにて, 1970)
2. Hohoemu Shounen (ほほえむ少年, 1972)
3. 20 no Hiru to Yoru (20の星と夜, 1973)
4. Star! (スター！, 1974)
5. Mister no Kotori (ミスターの小鳥, 1975)
synonyms: Yuki to Hoshi to Tenshi to

49092.description:
Protagonist Akira Yoshizawa's father remarries the mother of his childhood friends, the three Takai sisters. And the sex crazed zaniness ensues.

Notes:
• Published in COMIC Penguin Club Sanzokuban 2008-07~2009-05, 2012-05
• The manga had a reprint that includes an extra chapter

49094.description:
The end is nigh! Behind the truth of Sachiko's death lies a cruel and tragic past...The students of Class 2-9 struggle to hold on to their sanity as they fight both the ghosts of the school and the ever-encroaching Darkness that seeks to turn them against their friends. If they can't solve this mystery soon, it'll be too late! When living is this hellish, is death the only way out...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: コープスパーティー BloodCovered

49095.description:
The Vampire Bund, a peaceful island nation of vampires off the coast of Tokyo, ruled by Princess Mina Tepes, has seen its share of conflict and turmoil. And yet there are times of relative tranquility when the Bund is a popular tourist destination during daylight hours.

When two teenage tourists, Garcia Fujisaki and his reckless best friend Masaki, ditch their group to find a vampire who will turn Masaki, it’s Garcia who pays the price. Awakening as an unwilling creature of the night, Garcia finds himself entangled with a seedy band of terrorists looking to destroy the only known cure for vampirism. Garcia must find the cure and administer it within forty-eight hours, or his condition is irreversible!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Dance in the Vampire Bund Gaiden: Dive in the Vampire Bund
Dance in the Vampire Bund Sidestory: Dive in the Vampire Bund

title.native: ダイブインザヴァンパイアバンド

49097.description: Seto Hayato was heartbroken and had a one-night stand with a guy he met at the gay bar. Only to reunite with the same man, Sakaguchi Shuuichi, when the police arrived because of Seto's report of his apartment being robbed. Both were happy about meeting and after another night of talking, the two realize that they want to become closer to one another.

49098.description: Matataki is a high school student who enjoys photography. One day, he finds out that he can see the future when he looks through the viewfinder of his camera upon seeing the girl he likes, Mirai, kissing a stranger under a bell that is rumored to bring two people together for eternity...

49102.description:
Our protagonist is a normal guy with no luck when it comes to love; he's on an eternal quest for a girlfriend and dreams of romantic relationships, but the problem is that all the girls seem to be taken, or avoiding him altogether!

Meeting a girl can be hard, especially if you're clueless around the opposite sex and don't even know where to start.

Then, one day, everything changed. His friend Ade met a beautiful girl on the Internet and he was struck with a brilliant idea; why not seek love online?

(Source: Ephidel/MAL)

49104.description: Keicho era, with the Toyotomi and Tokugawa armies poised to clash at the edges of Sekigahara .... Jirosaburo, a wandering warrior, is by Tokugawa Ieyasu's side at the head of the army as his shadow. The two men are so similar that few can tell them apart -- save for the sharp eye of an assassin, lurking among the troops. When the real Tokugawa Ieyasu falls to the assassin's blade, Jirosaburo throws away his identity and assumes Ieyasu's destiny of conquest and unification.

49106.description:
1. Senpai's Secret Nectar
2. She's Up to Her Neck with Him!
3. Crazy about her Smell!
4. Ani-Mania (Older Brother Mania)
5. Ane-Mania (Younger Sister Mania)
6. Turn to Love
7. Twin Disguise
8. Onee-chan's Beloved
9. Chairman's Opposite
10. Yua Love
11. Yuzuha-san's First
12. Sibling Fantasy
synonyms: She's Up to Her Neck with Him!

49107.description: Oogami is a detective by day and exorcist by night, solving cases and hunting spirits together with his ghostly assistant Kazari. One day, a mysterious package with horrifying contents arrives in Oogami's mail, the only clue to its sender being the name of a remote village: Shirasunamura

49108.description: In a world where dead people turn into books and are stored in the Bantorra Library where anyone who reads a book can learn their past, Bantorra Library is maintained by Armed Librarians who wield psychic powers and their enemy is a religious society known as Sindeki Kyoudan.

49109.description: Gyeo-wool, an art student, is having having trouble drawing. One day, she bumps into a handsome guy and takes his notebook by mistake. The notebook had drawings with an art style she is not used to and tries to draw better than him. But, it turns out that the guy knows who she is...!

49110.description:
Chihiro is the heir to Tsurumaruya, an old, well-established Japanese confectionary. He is secretly in love with Katsumi, a childhood friend, who is also the manager of the store. His feelings for the over-protective Katsumi keep growing, but Katsumi wants to fulfill the last wish of the previous owner and live his life as the manager.

With the two of them unable to connect their feelings, Chihiro is asked to go to Tokyo by an important customer. The lives of the master and manager are bound by family tradition. In addition to this popular series is a story about a nephew who suddenly ends up living with President Mori and two new stories.

(Source: DMP)

49111.description:
Hm? What's wrong with cross-dressing?

En, a boy that our protagonist, Hinata, is really into, just confesses his feelings to her. She's excited to have her first boyfriend, but the truth is, En is an incredibly beautiful boy who hates men and enjoys cross-dressing!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Notes:
- Includes the one-shots "Sweets Honey" and "Amber".
- Includes 12 extra chapters.

49115.description: Popular honor student little brother, Yuua, and his kind older brother, Seigo. One step ahead in the puberty department, Seigo tries to put a little distance between him and his cute little brother. However, the innocent little brother is to blame with his defenseless skinship. Finally, Seigo's lust consumes him and he can't endure anymore. Once Yuua accepted that idea, his desire to be attached to his brother grew stronger every day. From "Teirui Makura." To taste the forbidden fruit, a collection of love songs.

49119.description:
1. Seitokaichou-sama no Pet (生徒会長様のペット); drap 2009-02
Nizaki Eito was just about to sneak back into the dorm after finishing his part-time job and ran into the student council president, Fujima. Because it was against the school rules, Nizaki agreed to become Fujima’s pet. When Nizaki started to get really popular, Fujima got jealous and decided to let go of him. However, Nizaki threatened Fujima instead and wanted Fujima to become his pet. Was it for love or for revenge?

2. Lovers Shake!; drap 2008-01
3-4. Boyfriend (ボーイフレンド); drap 2008-08~09
5. Tenohira no Ondo (てのひらの温度); drap 2009-06
Daisuke's been acting troubled at work lately, and is always being called to the HR department. His childhood friend Motoki wants to find out why, but when he asks he receives an answer he wasn't expecting: Daisuke asks Motoki, "Can I kiss you?"

6. Seitokai-shitsu no Koibito (生徒会室の恋人); kakioroshi

49126.description:
A hot paparazzi tries to take some shots of an idol Jin Aonishi, who is rumored to secretly set family-parties every night ... and gets "punished".

Note: 6 Pages Short One-shot Published in COMIC HOTMiLK 2008-02 Vol. 03

49130.description: The End of Rain was distributed at Comiket 73 by Kogado as a spin-off of their visual novel Symphonic Rain. It is an anthology containing four short stories written and illustrated by various people.

49133.description: A girl follows an attractive guy at school only to discover that he's in the paranormal club. Then it's discovered that she has psychic powers and the way to charge powers, as anyone knows, is sex. Though she may not want to, she'll have to have lots of sex if she's to fight demons.

49135.description:
Fantasy Action Legend that follows his brother's diary!!

After his brother Loki's death, on Tyr's 17th birthday, Loki's diary is delivered to Tyr. When following the diary step by step, Tyr realizes that everything that's happening around him is already recorded within the diary.

49137.description: Spinoff of the eponymous NDS game, focusing on the sweet Takane Manaka.

49143.description: A male science teacher and a female school nurse at a local school live in the same apartment building. Sometimes she visits his room and they drink together. A situation arises that causes some awkwardness in their relationship. Will they be able to resolve things?

49144.description: Hirasawa Asako really likes advertisement leaflets! Super rich young lady Kazuki Sakura moves to an all-girl high school which just happens to be in the same town in which Asako lives. Two completely incompatible people develop an intense but earnest battle of The Town vs Super Rich Young Lady! Can these two become good friends in the end?!

49148.description: Plot of the Kyattō Ninden Teyandee manga is the continuation of the anime series. The new plan of Ko'on-no-Kami to overthrow the Shogun is in action, Karamaru gets kidnapped, Wanko-no-Kami and Nyanki get fired from their position and everything goes wrong. What happens then - find out in this manga.

title.native: キャッ党 忍伝 てやんでえ

49154.description:
Shiki Yukitaka is desperate for money, but he makes way too little as a long term substitute teacher. While drinking one evening, a pretty woman asks if he would be willing to assassinate people for 5 million yen a kill. Although Shiki is hesitant, he grudgingly admits that he might do it, provided all the targets are serious evildoers. He soon finds that her offer is deadly serious, when she introduces him to the rest of the team and points them towards their first target. The driver, Yan, is doing this for the money as well. Shiki's partner, Kuzumi, is a cop. He doesn't appear to be interested in the money, but he seems to be driven by a deep anger.

On Shiki's first mission, things don't go quite as planned. They didn't count on their target's 18 year old daughter Itsuki being locked up in the house. She's been confined for 10 years, due to her spooky ability to read things from people's minds when she touches them. She claims to want to be their ally, and Shiki is reluctantly made responsible for her care. With the police investigating their crime, is keeping her alive too dangerous? How long will the team be able to get away with continuing their highly paid vigilante murders?

49155.description:
Gen's high school baseball team is in trouble when they lose their pitcher to injury. Gen, who is the catcher, finds a prospective new pitcher, Leo, playing with some neighborhood kids. But while Leo is an amazing pitcher, he refuses to join the team! After his pro-baseball-player father's career was ruined by stories of throwing a game for money, Leo decided he would never play baseball. Will Gen be able to help Leo move past his father's shame and forge his own identity as a baseball player?

Source: mangahelpers

49156.description: The day after he finds himself dumped by his girlfriend, Sorayama Shun recieves a letter... from himself? The letter was from Shun 25 years ago for his future self. The letter reminds him of the time when he dreamed of owning a Countach and being a successful professional racer. With loads of luck and his ambition to make his childhood dream come true, he finds himself as a new owner of an LP400 Countach.

49157.description: The Izanami High School soccer team is reeling after one of their own, Masaki, is killed unexpectedly in a traffic accident. It seems impossible to fill the gaping hole left in the team by Masaki's death. However, with one player short, they won't be able to go to any of the championships they had all dreamed about before. One day, a mysterious transfer student, Amakusa Kain, tries out for the soccer team, and his skills stun the team's ace! Will Kain be the push they need to move forward from this tragedy as a team and begin once again to chase their championship dreams?

49159.description: Neo Dragoon follows Masamune, a young, one-eyed general, in 1581, the Feudal era of Japan. The story begins in Castle Yonezawa, where Masamune lives under his father’s rule. He is ordered into his first battle: to reclaim the Igu territory from the enemy. Masamune is very ambitious and not only does he plan on ruling the neighboring lands, he envisions himself ruling over Japan and beyond it. He surrounds himself with loyal, smart and strong friends like Katakura Kojuurou, his second in command, Date Shigezane and Harada Munetoki, his lieutenants. His wife, Megohime, is beautiful and also skilled in combat. As Masamune takes his first step on his journey to conquer the land, the country and eventually the world, what perils await him?

49160.description:
In the year 1587, the Tokugawa clan is vigilantly looking for a way to destroy Toyotomi Hideyoshi. Hideyoshi depends on the resourceful, intelligent, but slender-looking samurai Sanada Yukimura, to help him protect his people and foil the plots of his enemies. He has also assigned the loud-mouthed, impetuous shinobi Sarutobi Sasuke to work with Sanada, to their mutual annoyance. Though they may hate each other, they're going to have to work together for Hideyoshi's sake!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title.native: 御指名武将真田幸村 かげろひ -KAGEROI-

49161.description:
Date Bashira is a series of stories about the Sengoku era in Japan. However, unlike most textbooks and historical mangas, Date Bashira does not focus on the Shogun or famous figures in history. Instead, it brings to light the untold stories of the things surrounding these famous figures. For example, one story tells about the role of how beautiful young men were always accompanying the shoguns into battle. As women were not allowed into a battle zone, the warlords would use these teenage boys to satisfy their sexual urges.

A different chapter tells the history of the wives of the Shoguns and focuses on the female role in the Sengoku era. As young women were forced into arranged marriages, usually as peace offerings or spies, their husbands usually die in battle at a very early age, as it was the era of war. Date Bashira discusses the idea of remarriage for these women and if they were really in love or were playing the role of a wife.

Date Bashira takes a different perspective at one of Japan’s most talked about era and even though it is informative, you never get the feeling of a lecture. The beautiful artwork, splash of comedy and the untold, yet interesting historical information really keeps the reader glued onto the pages.

49162.description:
Set at the end of the Edo (Tokugawa Shoganate) era, the series depicts Cloud's family with his wife, Turtle, their 11-year-old son and 8-year-old daughter. The Clouds are always ignoring work and playing. Cloud is notorious for womanising.

Note: Received the 1979 Shogakukan Manga Award for general category.

49163.description:
The city at the end of the railroad tracks, Minami, was once famous for its hot springs, but now it's just a small country town. While walking her dog one day, Satoko, who was born and raised in Minami, accidentally ends up discovering a new hot spring! However, she finds it on a construction site belonging to the neighboring city Kita.

Now the dispute arises; does this new hot spring belong to it's discoverer and the city of Minami, or to the owner of the land, Kita? Naturally, the best way to decide this is with a curling match! Since she's the hot springs founder, Satoko is going to be the Minami team's leader. Satoko and her friends are determined not to lose, but they don't really know anything about the sport of curling! Will they be able to defeat Kita and help Minami regain its hot springs fame!?

49165.description:
A Woman, A Mother, A Wife.

This is what she is, and yet she has been taken advantage of by a school kid - Raped with unbelievable positions. Her son begins to suspects things but has no clue.

How will she be able to maintain her life if she pledges to be a sex slave to A KID... ?

A SINFUL MOTHER is what she is.

Volume 1
1-9. Tsumi Haha (つみはは)
10. Hakuri (剥離)
11. Koneko (仔猫)
Volume 2
12-21. Tsumi Haha (つみはは)
22. Acmé (アクメ)

49166.description: In the year 1935, German Nazi agents infiltrate Mexico in order to locate and capture Kukulcan, an ancient Aztec god believed to be sleeping in the country encased by Jade.

49167.description:
Yotsuya-senpai, a mysterious student at an ordinary school who solves supernatural cases...only if you pay him with a good horror tail! Desperate to find her missing friend, Nakashima Makoto turns to the legend for help...What ties their search to the string of brutal child murders haunting the headlines? Two unlikely partners. One chilling truth. The mystery starts here.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Include the one-shots "Asobiba," "Ousama Kid" and the pilot one-shot.

title.native: 詭弁学派、四ッ谷先輩の怪談。

49171.description:
Ritz: The doll scientist.
Darlene: The doll created by Ritz...
Ritz begins teaching of the world, humanity, and how to become human to Darlene, who's existence revolves around his own, Ritz, but...

49177.description: Series of connected stories centering around couples at a boys school.

49178.description:
1) Mumyou Bonnou
The commander of the British army, Captain Errol, is captured by his enemy, a Hindu ruler called Bimbisara. But instead of killing Errol, Bimbisara decides to give him lessons on the Kama Sutra, in a very hands-on way.

2) Floral Sea Cavern
After falling overboard of a boat during his school trip, Kazamatsuri awakens to find himself imprisoned in a strange place by a man who has never heard sound of a beating human heart. He is told that he is in the netherworld, and that he will never be allowed to leave.

3) Taizan Kouroumu

4) Super Natural

5) Love Fortune

49181.description: Three young and upcoming pop singers are trying to figure out a way to get known and they eventually come to the conclusion that they lack the proper sex appeal...

49182.description: Ikewaki Gajirou, nicknamed Gacchan, is the most valorous of the Big 5 in his school. He's a pretty good person. However, he has one flaw that people fear him for...

49183.description: Sequel to Itaike na Bokura (chapters 5-6) and Yakkai na Bokura.

49184.description: The first girl to join a classroom, from the combination of a boys and girls school, is overwhelmed with love confessions.

49185.description:
Eva, a long-lived witch, takes in Fernest kingdom’s youngest prince, Louis, when she is asked to heal him of his illness. Although witches are traditionally despised, Louis continues to visit her even after he is well and they form a close bond. When Louis is called back to the palace to take his place as heir to the throne, Eva must decide whether to let him go or take him back.

Notes:
- Includes two volume-exclusive chapters: "Chiisana Koi no Uta (小さな恋のうた)" and " Good morning"
- Includes one omake chapter
- Includes the one-shot "Ouji-sama Sama no Jijou. (王子様サマの事情。)", published in LaLa DX 2007-11

49187.description: This Oneshot's about a delusional teacher that attacks students with a mutated creature, which is a combination of dissected frogs, called Dorn... In other words, it's a weird story but not necessarily in a good way.

49189.description:
The drama club of an all girl high school puts on the play "The Cherry Orchard" by Anton Chekhov for the anniversary of the school's founding.

Each chapter follows the life of one of the club members while the preparations for the play go on.

(Source: Wikipedia)

49191.description: Republication of Maki Kusumoto's work over the past two decades.

49195.description: Many people in this world were born with commonplace magical abilities. These are usually things that make their lives a bit more convenient, such as the ability to make a small flame, or to heal slightly more quickly than usual. But the young, brilliant lord of Seeker Castle has a little sister with incredible destructive magic powers, which he uses to kill anyone who threatens his territory. Also living with the lord and his sister is a boy whose magical powers are still a mystery. The story of their entwined destiny begins now!

49196.description:
Set in 2194 AD, China, which is now a prosperous, super-modern country. The characters are mostly reincarnations of warriors from the 3 Kingdoms period.

The story begins in Shin Yokohama with main chara Todoroki Ranshirou driving around & causing a ruckus with his bousouzoku called Yokohama Road Stars, when he gets a mysterious package from his father. Soon after he's attacked by Blades and makes an astonishing self-discovery... that he's the reincarnation of Sun Ce!

49200.description:
Yurin, the daughter of a low-level official, came into the royal palace after hearing about an amazing job with high pay. Unfortunately for her, that work entailed playing the role of a bride for the cold and ruthless Wolf King, Haku Reisho. After starting her work within the rear palace that’s rife with conspiracy, Yurin learned of His Majesty's secret. What will become of her fate?!

(Source: Comikey)

49201.description:
1. Shortsighted Adultery
Jun'ichi's Mother, Misako, is alway forgetting to put on her glasses, leading to misidentify, and Misako has Yuuki in her sights glasses on or off.

2. Ditsy Mama

3-5. Twin Mama
Arate's Mother leaves for a trip, but she fails to tell him that her twin sister, Haruko, will be staying with him for awhile. Looking just like his mother, seduces him. And when his mother returns even more sexual taboo's ignite.

6. Loving Mother
Toshiki's mother, Misaki, is always going over to his friend, Hirota's, house to fix him food because he doesn't have a mother of his own. One day Toshiko goes over there to check up on her and finds she making doing more then just making him food...

7. Mama Slave Boy
Goruo's dad leaves for a business trip leaving just him and his mother, and while he's away Goruo's mom just keep doing strange things to him that pushes him to his limits. When he stops by his friends house and see him having sex with his own mother. Gorou begins to loose control, especially when his own mother asks him to sleep with her.

8. Selfish Ruler, Older Sister King
Riena, the object of all the boys desires. When her little brothers friends force him to get a few naked pictures of her and a pair of her panties, things go awry.

9. Nurse Shiro
Nurse Shiro is the schools nurse, she's always taking care of everyone's injury's and sickness but with her husband away their is no one to take care of her needs. "Please train me to be your bitch" and with a click of the mouse, she starts her adventure of being a sex slave.
(Source: BakaBT)

49202.description:
1. Yuna (湯女)
2. Marina no Kyuujitsu (真里奈の休日)
3. Resort Happening (リゾートハプニング)
4. Poolside no Yuuwaku (プールサイドの誘惑)
5. Nureta Mermaid (濡れたマーメイド)
6. Nettai Shoujo (熱体少女)
7. Thrilling School (スリリングスクール)
8. Kotori-tachi no Yakata (小鳥達の館)
9. Nopan Date (ノーパンデート)
10. Kano Ane (かのあね)
11. Buchou Bureikou (部長無礼講)
12. Wakaokusama Soudanshitsu (若奥様相談室)
13. Mitsui (蜜衣)

49205.description:
Because of his much-too-strict character, the excellent and capable student council president, Hayami Reiichirou was isolated from his surroundings. But, one day, he is forced to take care of a kitten he received from his mother who is in the middle of divorce. Seeking help from the resident cat-lover in the student council, Shiraishi Kotoko, there is...?! (Source: Shoujo Crusade)

Also contains the one shot Gakuran Ouji.

49206.description: In a time when Gods ruled with cruelty, no one dared to oppose them... A girl was offered to the wind god as a sacrifice. A tribe leader sets off on a journey of redemption while trying to save the girl and make her his wife. Kiron, while defying the Gods will, departs for a difficult journey. Will he be successful? And what kind of obstacles will the Gods throw at him?

title.native: ドント・クライ・マイ・ベイビー

49210.description:
1-2. Ieraishan (夜来香)
3-5. Call Me: Abunai Houkago (CALL ME～あぶない放課後～)

49215.description:
"I'd let you do anything...Mr. Sakuma..."

This sometimes scandalous, sometimes heartwarming collection of short stories includes some of Miu Otsuki's steamiest work. From the forbidden affair between a history teacher and a demanding model student, to the adorably awkward budding romance between friends, these moving and bold stories are must-reads for any yaoi fan.

(Source: June Manga)

title.native: チャイム♪～ピーチな生徒とバナナな教師～』 大槻ミゥ
title.romaji: Chime: Peach na Seito to Banana na Kyoushi

49218.description:
Hayama Honoka, a freshman at Asaka High School, is an easygoing, unmotivated teenage girl that seems to be unaware that she is more interested in girls than boys. Tomori, her best friend since middle school who is a little violent at times, reminds her that she must pick a club to join at school. Soon after, during the lunch break, Honoka sees a girl wandering the old, abandoned campus building and meets a shy and clumsy girl named Mizusawa Yuzuki who finds fascination in the building that is several decades old although, Honoka only sees it as dirty.

Honoka and Yuzuki learn about a small school club called the Abandoned Building club. They meet the vice president of the club, Tachibana Mana, a very passionate and nicely-figured girl, and the two girls decide to join. The club’s purpose is to visit abandoned buildings, rooms or stations and see the beauty of the place that has been forgotten but which is full of history, places that are worn out by time, forgotten by people but filled with hints into the past.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

49219.description:
Masatsugu, a calligraphy sensei, liked his student, Sumiya, for a very long time. His feelings got stronger and he started to avoid eye contact with Sumiya. Sumiya sensed Masatsugu’s awkwardness and confronted him. They eventually did it and Sumiya didn’t look for Masatsugu anymore after that. Masatsugu came home one day to find Sumiya at his doorstep…

(Source: Attractive Fascinante)

49220.description: A small boy goes to gather firewood for his mother and frees a god.

49224.description: We look into a day of the life of Suu and Kina that have recently moved in together.

49228.description: Yoshino Shinya is a high school boy who is bullied all the time at school, which leads him to have no friends. However, no one knows that he is actually half-youkai, and due to that, he has the desire to eat human flesh. But because of the promise he made with his youkai father never to prey on humans, Shinya tries to resist his youkai blood that is thirsty for human's blood, and live as a normal high school student. Will he be able to keep the promise he made with his father and keep his secret hidden?

49233.description:
A young master with love troubles.
A short story with an unexpected ending!

49234.description: A collection of short stories by Yukimura.

title.english: The More Useless He is, The More I Love Him

49237.description: Shy Yanahara Taichi wants to be a voice actor, so he joins the closest thing he can find, which is the theatre club at his high school. The three girls of the club, big-breasted Shinobu, aloof Sae, and president Manaka are surprised to finally have a boy join up. They've decided to help him become an actor and are going to start by forcing him to overcome his shyness with girls.

title.native: かたぴら・おぺれった

49239.description: Children have been disappearing mysteriously and it has been a major concern to many parents. One parent is found wandering about the streets asking people if they've ever heard of the swallow that cries at night. A waitress who works at a bar guides her to the bar and allows her to discuss her situation. In the bar, the waitress, a bartender, and a little girl listen. Once she has finished talking, she leaves. Now all the waitress and bartender has to do is wait. The little girl disappears from the bar and she appears on the streets. She finds and traces the girl in question and follows her to discover...?

title.native: エンドルフィンマシーン

49241.description:
Eleanor who works at the castle is an ugly girl but has a very beautiful mind.
She changes into the beautiful girl refined only 30 hours by fairy's magic...

49243.description:
Masaya doesn't like breasts, but his sister thinks other...

Very nice incest oneshot..

49246.description: Demon brothers Tao Tie and Kui Long arrive at a village to prepare to recieve a ritual sacrifice that happens every 10 years. Kui Long introduces himself as Wu Chen to a girl named Tan Hua. Turns out Tan Hua actually died from an illness beforehand but her brother the doctor gave her a medicine that rivived her so that she would be the sacrifice and not him. Neither Kui Long nor Tan Hua know of eachothers role in the approaching ritual...

49252.description:
A limited edition special book collecting all the stories in the Koisuru series so far, including one extra:

1. Koisuru Shokubutsu (恋する植物)
Sports stars, Hiyama and Mizuno, find themselves caught up in something bigger than they first imagined when they go out to find out whether or not their fathers are really gay.

2) Koisuru DNA (恋するDNA | Love DNA)
Hiyama and Mizuno are back for more trouble!

3) Koisuru Baby Leaf (恋するベビーリーフ)

4) Koisuru DNA+ (恋するDNA＋| Love DNA+); kakioroshi extra
Hiyama Papa and Mizuno Papa reminisce about a passionate meeting in their youth.

49253.description:
Because of some bad luck, Aikawa Towa's recent problem is the complicated relationship between the devilish student council president, Shirahane Mikado. Kissing is not the only thing... but is this friendship?! What's more, Mikado started to take a part time job to find relief, but... his bad friends, Shinonome and Yukimura saw their kiss scene...?! Eh?! Will two guys be "lovers"...?!

(Source: Princes)

49256.description:
A Slice-of-Life, Comedy, Sports manga about a girl, often called as Zawa (short for her surname, Miyakozawa), in a high-school baseball team. She's talented, but being a girl, she doesn't get to participate in any official matches, and yet she trains just as hard as the rest of the team anyway, just for her own personal satisfaction.

Chapters are short and frequently done from the perspective of some passer-by/s interacting with or even just watching and contemplating to themselves about Zawa and/or the rest of the baseball team.

title.native: 高校球児 ザワさん

49257.description:
Ozu Kotarou (25) recently changed his career from a white collar worker to a high school teacher. His new workplace is at Odawara High School, a girls only school. He starts off his first day by leaving a significant impression on the entire school by announcing that he has no interest in younger girls, especially underage girls.

Kotarou is assigned to assist Hara Takako, a fellow teacher, until he gets experience teaching. Hara is a beautiful 32 year old woman but is insecure about being single and is worried about her future. How will the relationship between these two people develop as they start working closely together? Hakuba no Oujisama is a must read for any romance genre lover.

49260.description: A collection of eight short stories featuring busty females.

49261.description:
A collection of short stories about married women being raped, including some stories about both mothers and their daughters being raped.

From BakaBT

49262.description:
Based on DS Dating Sim "Love Plus"

Aikawa Wataru's father is being transferred overseas. Seeing this as a perfect opportunity, Wataru decides to stay behind in Japan and live on his own. Even though he's a new transfer student, his teacher convinces him to become a Library Representative. A fellow Library Rep tells him they’re missing a member and asks Wataru to find her. Not knowing how she looks like, he wanders the school trying to find her only to notice two girls gossiping about her negatively. It turns out the person he's looking for isn't well liked, because of her bad personality.

Her name is Kobayakawa Rinko, but what's the source of her bad attitude?

title.native: リンコデイス Rinko Days

49263.description:
1. Sagashimono (さがしもの)
2. Nayami no Tane (悩みのタネ)
3. Kesenai Toge (消せない棘)
4. Shissou beat (疾走beat)
5. Aoi Kami Hikouki (青い紙ヒコーキ)

49265.description:
When Takagi Akira, an owner of an apartment, was in town, he ran into a scene where a man, Oodoi, saved an old man from a gang. Akira fell for Oodoi’s manly courage and took him in his apartment. Oodoi found Akira’s apartment comfy and spent time there. Akira thought Oodoi's manly act was now part of the past... But when Akira was harassed by mobs and about to sell his apartment, it was Oodoi who saved his life. Truth is, Oodoi is a yakuza and…

(Source: Nakama)

49266.description:
Satoshi Onoe, a reporter for a weekly magazine, has a new stakeout partner, and he’s anything but thrilled about it. Photographer Motoharu Kaburagi’s unconventional reporting methods and overall bad attitude are enough to drive Onoe insane. But the more the two work together, the closer they get.

(Source: SuBLime)

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

49269.description: Chieri (Cherry) was living an ordinary life, until her sister Ichigo (Strawberry) suddenly left her child Momo (Peach) on Chieri's doorstep. Momo is an infant; how is Chieri supposed to take care of a baby while still in high school!? To make matters even more frustrating, two guys are fighting for Chieri's love...!? (Source: Nagareboshi Manga)

49270.description:
22-year-old Hatanaka Seri is the daughter of a family with great wealth, but no historically significant name. 22-year-old Furumidou Yuzuki is the son of a family with a prestigious background that no longer has much money. From their parent's perspectives, a marriage between them is not only mutually beneficial but extremely desirable. Seri, however, is dead set against it. Not only does she hate being forced to do something that is not of her own accord, she cannot see how their marriage could even work.

They may have been friends when they were young children, but she and Yuzuki have since grown apart and at present, don't even like each other. Fully expecting Yuzuki to agree, she is surprised to find out that he is at ease with their parents' decision. Is he just too lazy to rebel against his family or is there a much more mysterious and sinister explanation for his desire to get married so quickly?

title.native: あなたに花を捧げましょう

49271.description: The Highland and the City-State have signed a peace treaty ending their war, but one night, on the camp of Highland's army of young men called the Unicorn Brigade, a massacre occurred, with only Tao and Jowy as the only survivors. They discover that the one behind this was the Highland prince, Luca Blight, and now, they were branded traitors of their own country...

title.native: 幻想水滸伝II‐引き裂かれし宿星
title.romaji: Gensou Suikoden II: Hiki Sakareshi Shukusei

49274.description: All teen girls in town wake up one morning transformed into old men...followed by some pretty awkward situations where the main characters fall in love with each other. Are they lesbians? gays? or is that a fujoshi's dream come true?
synonyms: Oyaji na! - Chinatsu to Tomoe no Baaii

title.native: おやじな! ~千夏と巴の場合~

49277.description:
Lysa, a student at Academy of Magic, is a Guardian Candidate who is training to become the key Guardian. She befriends the twin Protector Candidates Nels and Kallus, competes with a talented girl named Werther who likes to complains about everything, and is encouraged by an elite Protector Candidate named Siler.

However, when she wakes up one day, she finds that it seems like the world is heading towards the end...!?

Is Lysa the key to the end of the world......!?

(Source: Kurofune Zero, translated)

title.native: 白紙魚取扱店 美鬚堂

49279.description:
Glasses Cafe GLASS is...
A cafe where all the garcons wear glasses. For the sake of women who like glasses, the garcons are all beauties that wear glasses. It's a specialty cafe. From the start, the owner hired exceptional men as garcons.

And then a puzzling event occurrs...!?
This cafe of boundless peril is Kotaro's fate!

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra and one 4-koma chapter.

49283.description: Like a typical teenager, there is nothing Tsubaki Ryuuta wants more than to not stand out from the people around him. Unfortunately, on his way to school one day, he is run over by an alien. The alien promptly resurrects him, but now he has superpowers that he can't control. The alien, now in sparrow form, attempts to help guide him, but there's no way for a kid who's constantly breaking things and has an alien sparrow perched on his shoulder to blend in at school. For his part, the alien is completely bewildered Ryuuta's continuing refusal to use his superpowers to fight crime and evil. Will Ryuuta be able to get over his self-consciousness and embrace his new life?

49284.description: "A Drop of Ocean," by Takahashi Mako, is a short summer story about two friends.

49285.description: Shio, a female high school student who can see spirits, was saved from a dangerous situation by a black cat. Afterwards, this cat kissed her, sucking out her spirit power. Then it changed to an unrivalled handsome boy! What’s more, he vowed to protect her in exchange for her spirit power!

49288.description:
Gyul, the outcast of the entire school, who used to be unable to get away from dangers without Ri Rang's help becomes strong with a sword obtained at an antique shop?!

Hot-tempered, unruly fighter Woo Ri and
my best friend Gyul suddenly seems different?
My heart beats when I see Gyul!!
Without knowing my eyes turned to look at his lips, and I could feel myself blushing.
This is not a disease, is it?

49291.description: Shijo Kei has no interest in men younger than 40! Because of this fetish, he had gotten into numerous indecent relationship and heartbreaks. His kohai, Hiro, can always be counted on to comfort Kei as his “cushion”. Until one day, facing yet another Kei’s self-inflicted anguish, Hiro finally snapped and declared, “Try me!” before he crushed a totally stunned Kei into the bed with his pent-up passion!! Can Kei’s broken heart be mended by the sweet pain of a younger man’s vigorous embrace… (Source: Nakama)

title.native: 恋とカラダは背中から
title.romaji: Koi to Karada wa Senaka kara

49292.description: Rai is a space opera that fuses feudal Chinese and Japanese customs with vast galaxy spanning empires and space-going societies. The story follows the life and times of the samurai Rai, and the quest of several spacefaring factions for control of territory and, of course, the Empire.
synonyms: Rai - La leggenda degli eroi delle guerre galattiche

49295.description: Spin-off of the DS Dating Sim "Love Plus." Features Nene Anegasaki.

49301.description:
When impressionable young Natsume receives a love letter from a handsome freshman, he falls in love at first sight. Natsume goes to find his admirer to confess that the feelings are mutual, but he is shocked when he is harshly rebuked. In order to discover the one who is truly worthy of his heart, Natsume must unravel a tangled web of miscommunication and secret admirers.

The long-awaited manga by Kashio, Switch On! is a collection of short stories that features young men falling in love for the first time.

(Source: Juné)

49305.description:
Grooming : Megu and Yuzuru Natsu are orphans. Yuzuru wants to take the place of his parents as a guardian and protect his sister until she becomes the finest adult she can be... Unfortunately for him Megu has WAY more perverted dreams than those.

Source: mangaupdates

49308.description:
The time is the not-so-distant future and the planet Earth is under attack by an army of merciless aliens. Its only hope is the Starlight—a craft originally designed to realize man’s dream of traveling between the stars—and it’s genetically altered human pilot Mitsuha (codename: Silbuster). Inside of her and her four siblings lay the secret to completing the ship’s light wave engine. Only then can the alien threat be destroyed once and for all. Unfortunately, the creatures are well aware of this fact and will stop at nothing to destroy the adventurous family. Silbuster and crew must use their awesome powers and abilities to fend off the aliens until the key to humanity’s salvation can be uncovered. (from Atomic Avenue.com).

Publication information can be found under 'More Info'

49309.description:
A collection of various short stories from all types of genres.
There is something to please everyone in this collection, including a supernatural thriller and the story of a magical girl Kagyua and her not-so-human sidekick!

49310.description:
Two sisters on their way to learn new magical skills travel through a world whose technology stems from dragons. They will meet both friends and foes on their dangerous quest - and learn a little about themselves on the way!

See 'More Info' for Jp/US publishing data.

49312.description:
Official comic anthology for Akaiito that came with the limited edition version of the PS2 game.

1. Sho Damashi Yasui (章騙しやすい, Easy to Deceive)
2. Sora no Yume (空の夢, An Empty Dream)
3. Kikenna Yushoku (危険な夕食, Dangerous Dinner)
4. Kako no Yami (過去の闇, Past the Darkness)
5. Chi wa Mizu Yori Mo Kokunai?! (血は水よりも濃くない！, Blood Isn't Thicker than Water?!)
6. Anata wo Mamoritai (あなたを守りたい, I Want to Protect You)
7. Shoujo no Kokoro no Itami (少女の心の痛み, The Painful Feelings in a Girl's Heart)
8. Manatsunoyorunoyume, Soshite Yume (真夏の夜の夢、そして夢, A Midsummer Night's Dream, and Dream)
9. Yakusoku (約束, Promise)

title.native: アカイイト　アンソロジーコミック

49315.description: Raimon Middle School 's soccer club captain, Endou Mamoru is in a pinch - his club is about to be destroyed! Literally! To avert the wrecking ball and disbanding of the club, his team must win against the toughest soccer team in the area - Teikoku. Will Endou and his team meet a crushing defeat or will a mysterious transfer student with a fiery kick save them from disaster?!

49317.description:
The story begins with a scene of regret, chaos, and desperation. Sora lives with his little sister, Ann, and his rather comical father. Ann is the soloist of her school's chorus, and Sora is an awesome cook. Sora prepares his "honki" (serious) bento for his sister's school concert. Once Ann begins her solo, a mysterious force creates a rift in reality, as Ann's existense shatters right before everyone's eyes. Sora runs in to save her, but he too becomes part of this dark ritual. As Sora ends up transported to a fantasy world full of gigantic mushrooms, nothing seems to be certain on what will happen to these two.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

49318.description: A collection of stories about relationships between men and women either of whom just happens to be a zombie.

title.native: ゾンビ ロマンチシズム

49321.description: Housen is a painter of erotic art in the Edo period, who stumbles into a murder mystery involving women who have hooked up with one of his patrons. With the help of Tsubaki, a girl he runs into on the street who seems to know more about him than he does and is an artist herself, they start unraveling mysteries involving sex, murder, and occasionally the occult...

49323.description:
Taking inspiration from the Russian classic Crime and Punishment and then placing the behemoth of a book into a modern metropolis, Ochiai Naoyuki retells Dostoevsky's drama from the eyes of a struggling Japanese writer. In the 2006 remake Crime and Punishment ~A Falsified Romance~ Ochiai's lead is an incredible talent with award winning abilities. Tachi recently placed as the Best New Writer in a major literary competition, but the stress of living up to his family's goals of him becoming a powerful man has broken him on the cusp of greatness. He dropped out of college. However after moving to Tokyo he struggles with his identity and the duality of life in this surreal megalopolis. Despite being recognized for his tremendous potential, success does not come quite as easy, and life is a constant struggle. For Tachi Miroku life is nothing but a battle, with his past and his moral fiber. He hasn't been to work in four months and his dreams are a total mess filled with abuse, taunting, and the strong smell of blood. Tachi is alone and without direction in life right now. You could say he is a hikkikomori but that is only where his troubles start.

(Source: Otaku Magazine)

title.english: Crime and Punishment: A Falsified Romance
title.romaji: Tsumi to Batsu: A Falsified Romance

49324.description:
Lou Jie is a legendary street basketball player. His Uncle, a shady character, desperately wants him to go to the best sports college in China so that one day Lou Jie can play in the NBA. Lou Jie has plans that don't include basketball, however fate may have something else in mind...

(Source: Manyou Wenhua, translated)

49325.description: Saya is part of a special prefectorial board that aims to eliminate a dark association and, in the process, she drags Riki Naoe into the mayhem as back-up! Riki, not quite sure what's going on, is pretty sure all this is a plot by his senior, Kyousuke Natsume. Will Riki be able to get out of all the madness or will he get himself killed before he even tries?
synonyms: Little Busters! Ecstasy: Tokido Saya - School Revolution
Little Busters! Ecstasy: Sasasegawa Sasami - Black Cat Fantasia
Little Busters! Ecstasy: Futaki Kanata - My Minroud

49327.description: Soon Celcia's 15-years-in-office-annivisary is to be held, and Ritsuko wants to participate. But from her idea of going peacefully into the world of the Elves, a sudden invasion from the Elven world into Jimboumachi, Tokyo begins.

title.native: エルフを狩るモノたちリターンズ

49329.description:
Yagami-kun's Family Affairs follows Yūji Yagami, a high school student with a problem: his mother, Nomi, looks very young and Yūji has a crush on her. To complicate matters, his high school homeroom teacher is also infatuated with her due to how young she looks. Nomi is oblivious to all of this and is head over heels in love with her husband, Yōji, and frequently displays this affection very publicly, which causes more embarrassment for Yūji.

Yūji's high school friends constantly tease him about his "mother complex". When Valentine's Day comes around, though, Yūji receives a box of handmade chocolates. The name on card can be read multiple ways, the most common way being Masayuki Ikari (五十里 真幸, Ikari Masayuki?), a male name, so his friends tease him throughout the day until it's time to meet the person who sent the chocolates at the front gate after school.

The girl who sent the chocolates (the name is actually read "Mayuki") starts meeting him after school so they can walk home together, and they eventually become an item. The remainder of the story follows Yūji and Mayuki as their love grows and as Yūji works to resolve his "mother complex" issues.

(Source: Wikipedia)

49333.description: Chibana Manabu has a habit of closing his eyes and counting to three whenever he finds himself stressed out, whether it's about his drag-queen father or the feelings he's harboring for his childhood friend. Kaji Hiroto is carefree and enjoying his days with Chibana, hoping they'll last forever and maybe even turn into something even more eternal. But lack of communication and a fear of rejection can only lead downhill.

49334.description:
My father died when I was small, and my mother was a first-ranked maid, who left me in the charge of my grandparents. The last time I met her was when she was 36.
Out of curiosity, I plunge into the world of maids. I wait on young master Rain, and study at the school for maids. And master Rain's brother.... he is.... what's my feeling for him anyway? Could it be love?

And just you wait, I will be Cinderella.

49335.description:
Though we often regret what we say,
it is still impossible to undo those mistakes.
Even in proverbs they teach "think thrice before you say it".
Yet, if there is something you want to change no matter what
and there appears a time machine,
Would you use it?
I know I would.

"Even if I dedicated my life to music,
My heart beats with you.
How can I live-
How can you leave me."

"As my heart beats at another boy,
I thought it was over between you and me.
If I said I wanted to go back to the way it was...
Cruel?"

49336.description:
Every time you sent me one of your fake smile, my fists clench automatically
If I had a gun in my pocket, I would have shot you.

Tied by a secret that keeps him from loving the one he loves, Choi EunJo.
The handsome and much beloved idol Im Sol - no girl can resist his killer smile.

But for Narae, all she feels is disgust.
Bam!!
Where will Narae's Love Bullet fly?

49344.description: Amamiya Shin is a high school girl with no friends, and too shy to make any. One day during lunch, she finds a boy lying in the hallway. When he wakes up, he asks her for her name. His name is Haruki, a third year, and obviously a playboy. His first approach wasn't so chaste either. Even after Shin rejects him, he continues to show up every day. He nicknames Shin "Kami-chan" because she seems to have come straight from God. Shin falls quickly for him, and one day after class they make out.

49348.description:
The story centers around Ryōko Ōkami, a high school freshman girl known for her fierce looks, unusual canine teeth when she smiles, and wild demeanor. (Her family name is homonymous with the Japanese word for "wolf.") Ringo Akai is a short high school freshman girl with seemingly cute, angelic looks but a dark demeanor. (Her name is a Japanese wordplay on "apple" and "Red Riding Hood.") Together with their odd friends, the two fight to change the world, one issue at a time.

(Source: AnimeNewsNetwork)

49352.description:
Avoiding Deguchi for a long time, Onoda feels uncomfortable but cannot come up with a solution. He thinks lots of details about two men's relationships and tries to make this thing easy for himself. But Deguchi gets impatient and visits him at the end. Onoda agrees to go out with him but they cannot have sex for two months just because Onoda's confusion about intercourse.

In second part, Onoda gets jealous of Deguchi and takes him home some night. What will happen after they finally get together for such thing?
synonyms: Doushitemo Furetakunai dj - The World with Color

49354.description:
1. Wana Wana Kiss
Nagi and Natsuki became good friends because of a mischievous act Natsuki did. Nagi fell in love with Natsuki and started taking care of him. Natsuki didn't realize his own feelings and ran away from Nagi after they spent a night together. What would Nagi do to make Natsuki return to his side? (Source: Attractive Fascinante)

2. The God's Lamb
3. Bed

4. Ijimekko (Bully)
Suga-sensei is worried about a student, Rin, being bullied by another tattoo student, Rikudou. He couldn't leave Rin alone and try to find out the truth. Is he able to rescue Rin from the clutches of Rikudou and others?

5. Akkun and Onii-chan
6. I'm Sorry
7. Nagi (Wana Wana Kiss extra)

49356.description:
Design school students Issei (interior design) and Jin (photography), on their way home from a live concert, pick up a discarded cardboard box, only to find that it contains a pair of sexy underwear with a "special" attachment...!! Deciding to have some fun, Issei puts them on and poses for Jin, but when Jin finds when he aims his camera at Issei, his sexual desire goes through the roof!! What will happen when Jin finds he can't hold back anymore and has to have Issei right then and there?!

(Source: 801 Media)

49358.description:
Shuto Katsuragi is a superhero otaku. Only problem is, he's too short and always getting teased for his height...especially when he tries to emulate his favorite superhero! To make matters worse, Shuto suddenly gets abducted and tricked into participating in some rather sketchy and super-villainous experiments!

(Source: VIZ Media)

49360.description: Based on the song Ark by Sound Horizon

49361.description: Keiichi's twin sister, Saki has been in a coma for 10 years due to a traffic accident. As bad as that is, it's about to get worse because Keiichi's father is a brain surgeon who will stop at nothing to see to it that his daughter is brought back to life! (mangaupdates)

49362.description:
Kako Saeki is a senior in high school. She has been modeling and harboring her love for her favorite art teacher, Enjoe. Her heart breaks when she finds out that her love is actually engaged. Now, Kako's innocent love takes a dangerous turn when she finds out who is he engaged to.....

(Source: Evil Flowers)

Included One Shot: Beautiful World

One night Kosaka is looking for Mikimoto... but finds him having sex with the company president! So what does Kosaka do? Through logical thinking to the wind and join them to form a threesome! (Duh!)

49365.description:
Based on the Idolmaster Dearly Stars DS game.

Ryou has always had a problem with his feminine appearance. As a child he was often mistaken as a girl, and to his disappointment, that didn't change even after he got to high school. One day he came up with his best idea yet for gaining masculinity; he decided to become a male idol!

His cousin Ritsuko worked in the idol industry, so she was able to get him an audition. Unfortunately for his master plan, the company decided that he would make a wonderful female idol. Now, to even have a chance at becoming a male idol, he must first become successful as a girl!

title.native: The iDOLM@STER: ノイエグリーン for ディアリースターズ
title.romaji: The iDOLM@STER Dearly Stars: Neue Green

49370.description:
Compilation of various Iwaaki one-shots published between 1985 and 1990, including the title story Hone no Oto and his debut work Gomi no Umi, which was selected for the 12th Chiba Award.

The stories are collected in the following order:
1. Sea of Garbage [ ゴミの海 ]; Morning Open Special Edition (1985)
2. Unfinished [ 未完 ]; Morning THE Open Issue #A, (1988); Selected for the 13th Chiba Award.
3. Dreams that kill [ 夢が殺す ]; Morning THE Open Issue #C (1988)
4. The Day of the Ring [ 指輪の日 ]; Morning THE Open Issue #E (1989)
5. Watayama [ 和田山 ]; Morning THE Open Issue #D (1989)
6. Sound of Bones [ 骨の音 ]; New story realized purposely for 1990's Hone no Oto tankobon edition.
7. What I remember as an Assistant [ アシスタントで覚えた事 ]; 4 page extra story realized only for the 1990's Hone no Oto Masterpiece Edition.

49371.description:
A collection of eight oneshots (some related) by Kumota Haruko, all of which ran in Tokyo Mangasha's "Themed Catalogue" series under the Marble Comics line.

Includes:
1. Madobe no Kimi (Shokugyou Catalogue)
2. Good Bye, Honey (Salaryman Catalogue)

7. Daitai Iro ni Tokeau (Seme x Seme Catalogue)
8. Tecchan to Yasu no Kyuujitsu (short omake)

49372.description:
Kasumi was given a name favored by the gods so she would always be protected. Yet, when there is a drought in her village, she's the one chosen as the human sacrifice to go to beg the gods for rain. Her parents are sad, but Kasumi goes anyway. When she gets to the heavens, they try to send her back, but she won't go until her village sees rain, and now she's determined to become a fairy of the heavens. If it'll take 1000 years to learn to ride the clouds, she knows she'd better start now!

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

49375.description:
Eiji Fuwa is a former journalist, who traveled extensively. he was converted in the teaching of English. He was hired as a temporary school. Eiji is so calm and relaxed that it seems almost glacial, but the Japanese student's amorphous side surprises him.he will also find out that that some students quickly disrupted. Marked by the death of too many children in countries at war in which he worked, Eiji is given the mission to assist these students in trouble! Eiji is so calm and relaxed that it seems almost glacial, but the amorphous side of the Japanese students were stunned. It will also identify students quickly disrupted. Marked by the death of too many children in countries at war in which he worked, Eiji is given the mission to assist these students in trouble!

(Source: Manga-News translated by Moya@MAL)

49376.description:
Hirose Tomoko, a music conservatory student, never found the time to forge new friendships because of how dedicated and hardworking she was as a flute player. Then again, she was never a social bee like her active friend and fellow student-flute player, Okamoto Hiromi. Will Okamoto-san be able to convince Tomo-chin of her sincerest intentions or will Tomo-chin spend another Christmas alone with her flute?

(Source: Egio)

49379.description:
Enter Shokugyou Koroshiya, an underground website that allows hired killers to bid for the lowest amount to take the paying job that they want. Kumo, the top killer of the agency must keep killing to keep a memory hidden. While he continues to kill, along with Megumi the Mantis, and KEI, the 14 year old owner of the website, what dangers await him and the rest of the team at Shokugyou Koroshiya?

Warning - There is extreme sex and violence in almost every chapter.

49380.description: A cute story about a professor and his adorable kitten.
synonyms: The Professor's Kitten and the Rainy Morning

title.romaji: Hakase no Koneko to Ame no Asa

49381.description:
Fate/school life is a comedy 4-koma manga revolving around the normal life at school of the minor characters of Fate/stay night and Fate/Hollow Ataraxia, specifically the character Himuro Kane, classmate of Fate/stay night protagonist Emiya Shirou.

This manga by Mashin Eiichirou is a spin-off that tells the normal school life of the supporting characters Himuro Kane, Makidera Kaede, Saegusa Yukika. Other characters are the regular cast of the main games: Mitsuzuri Ayako, Tohsaka Rin, Ryuudou Issei, Matou Shinji, Emiya Shirou, Kuzuki Souichirou, Fujimura Taiga, Matou Sakura, Mitsuzuri Minori; "guest" characters from other series Ciel, Seven, Sajyou Ayaka (formerly the heroine of the never finished prototype novel of Fate/stay night) are also featured, and other classmates Gotou Gai, Fujimoto, Dezaki, Hirumata.

The story is centered around classic school events such as a ball game tournament, field trips and inter high school competitions. As such, there is no reference at all to supernatural things like magecraft and Heroic Spirits.
br> Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

49383.description:
In the fictional Tokyo suburb of Mahoro, Keisuke Tada works as a "benriya" - a general problem solver for hire.

One day in January, former classmate Haruhiko Gyoten appears unannounced. Back in their schooldays Gyoten was a quiet person who rarely talked. Now, Gyoten won't stop talking. Both men are over 30 years old and divorced. Without giving an explanation, Gyoten suddenly asks to spend the night at Tada's home. Tada turns down Gyoten, but Gyoten is persistent and Tada finally relents and allows him to sleep over for one night. What Tada is unaware of is that Gyoten plans to stay for more than one night. Eventually, Tada accepts Gyoten as his assistant and they become involved in various cases involving an assortment of people from different walks of life.

Chapter count includes two extras

49384.description: Uju and her friends are crow tengu who attend a special tengu training school. These tengu gain power by summoning gods. In order to show up a snobby exchange student tengu, Uju decides to summon a legendary, sleeping god in a ancient shrine. But what will happen when her plan actually succeeds? (Source: Mangahelpers)

An OL (office lady) with a broken heart decides to visit her childhood friend in hopes of staying overnight only to find a man living in her friend's house as her "roommate".

Collection of 23 stories about love in the everyday life of the Japanese.

1. His Scent
A woman reflects upon finding the scent of her lover from two years ago.
2. Heavy and Pop (♂)
A broke youngster starts selling him to an old lady.
3. Painfully from the Heart
Showing the connection between pain and love.
4. Holiday
A woman spends a day at home with her depressed boyfriend.
5. Heavy and Pop (♀)
A prostitute thinks about the concept of love.
6. A Place One Likes to Return To
A young woman who meets her ex-boyfriend and has sex with him gets confused about feelings for her current lover and her ex.
7.-8. The Silent Radiance
A girl unexpectedly meets her old womanising crush.
9. Small and Lovely
An Office Lady fed-up with her surroundings looks forward to meeting her darling.
10. At the Park
Two best friends, one of them whose name is Yoko, spends time with each other as they set of fireworks at the park, but there is a meaning behind their get-together. What is the reason for it?

49393.description:
A natural match between the manga queen Moyoco Anno and the patron saint of otaku, Hideaki Anno! When Moyoco Anno, the widely successful creator of women's manga, married Hideaki Anno, creator of Evangelion and a director known to be the very model of an otaku, she held one important doubt: "Am I really ready to be an otaku's wife?" Taking up that challenge, Moyoco Anno launched herself into the deep and beautiful world of married life. This comic essay, an account of the private lives of two of Japan's most high-profile creators, is raw, unfiltered, and unforgettably hilarious

(Source: Crunchyroll)
